# An acquired nonselective preparation from noisy experiment contrasts

24 October 2026. The owned question and observable representation were saved in `FIRST_CONSTRUCTION.md` before peer exposure. This construction replaces the initially contemplated full-operator fit by a directly estimable contrast. It is separate from the earlier quadratic-permutation acquisition theorem and from the previous predictive-depth experiments.

## Supplied apparatus and acquired information

There is a stationary controlled stochastic process. Each primitive action has a finite visible outcome alphabet. All action/outcome histories, their conditional future experiments, and their nonselective mixtures belong to one linear observable process whose **full controlled Hankel rank is at most two**. This is an architecture promise, not something inferred from nine frequency cells. It includes all legal observation-conditioned histories, not merely the marginal open-loop sensor sequence. The empty event has probability one. Loss, termination and timing observations must be included in the specified interface or excluded by an explicit apparatus contract.

The learner is supplied: that rank upper bound; a reproducible initializer of the entire relevant process at cost C_init; legal primitive controls and their costs/durations; a finite declared preparation/control library; and independent initialized Bernoulli trials of declared event settings. It receives integer outcome counts, not exact probabilities, hidden states, transition matrices, a coordinate map, a reset control, a stationary sampler, or an equivalence oracle. The initializer is used and paid during acquisition. A conditional reset below becomes usable only after this acquisition succeeds.

Choose one legal binary continuation event G. Let p(rho)=Pr(G|rho). Actual nonselective preparations P_i from the initializer, and actual nonselective controls u in a finite library U, are measured through

    p_i = Pr(G | P_i rho0),
    q_iu = Pr(G | u P_i rho0).

Order here is chronological: P_i, then u, then G. Outcomes inside a nonselective preparation/control are discarded; G alone contributes the observed bit. No postselection is free. Every episode pays its initializer, all controls, and all outcome production/readout.

# Scientific checkpoint: acquire a preparation that enables later experiments

24 October 2026. The protected learning line remains independent of the fresh physical/material line. The prior quadratic-permutation proof, distinct capped-quotient supplement, whole reviews and finite full-sort wins remain preserved in `../learning_opportunity/`.

## Operation achieved

The new question is whether costly initialized observations can acquire a new, cheaper preparation intervention for later scientific learning. The representation was selected independently in `FIRST_CONSTRUCTION.md`: complete controlled continuation probabilities, without supplied latent states, matrices, reset words or samplers.

`DIRECT_CONTRAST_THEOREM.md` gives the load-bearing operation. A supplied full controlled Hankel rank bound two plus an **acquired nonzero preparation gap** exhausts the observable space. Direct control contrasts identify the sole memory-dependent slope. A fitted positive mixture has a uniform, all-history, all-future visible-event/trajectory-TV certificate

    epsilon = (implemented empirical contrast residual + 2w)
              / (absolute acquired gap - 2w)^2,

clipped at one. It is valid after same-data selection of the pair/mixture because all declared count cells have simultaneous coverage. It includes arbitrary finite future feedback protocols and extends to the ordinary infinite transcript sigma-algebra. It does not reconstruct or assume a latent positive cone, a hidden-state ID or a supplied conditional sampler. The complete rank bound, stationarity and private nonselective controller are real supplied promises.

The learned operation resets the future **after its word/key/readout record is withheld**, at a common public completion time. The two legal reset controls each genuinely last one time unit; no free idle/padding exists in this fixture. Selection uses a fixed 16-bit draw. The Python source does not implement or certify physical entropy, record erasure, isolation or constant-time hardware. Its private PRNG object persists inside the simulator. The mathematical theorem requires fresh independent private entropy and continuing record isolation. Releasing the reset word invalidates the general claim (the exact I/swap joint-record TV counterexample equals one).
